Thanks for the ping — I reviewed Caroline's notes and the MSA redline. Quick positions below (we should keep this tight for sales/legal alignment):

1) Term: We can agree to a 12-month renewal if Nimbus accepts a 9% price uplift vs the 24-month rate and commits to an upfront payment schedule (30% upfront, rest at 60 days). This protects unit economics and addresses their ask.

2) Data residency: Offer an EU data residency addendum limited to production inference payloads for EU-located customers; include language that logs/telemetry may remain in primary region unless they elect Redwood Private (which we should price out). We cannot guarantee on-prem for third-party managed add-ons in the standard hosted plan.

3) Audit rights: Provide SOC2 Type II report annually and a targeted log export for agreed scopes (business-critical request), with any in-depth audits handled under a separate SOW and billed. Limit audit frequency to once per 12 months.

I’ll prepare a redline that accepts their 12-month ask with the above commercial levers. Laura — from CS perspective, are there migration or timing concerns if we target July 1 for added capacity?
